verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code-first engine. The evidence shows a complete programmatic scene graph via NPM/ES6 modules with full TypeScript typings, plus headless/server-side execution via NullEngine, so most capabilities are inherently API-driven. However, the visual tools (Inspector scene editing, Node Material Editor, Sandbox) are documented only as UI tools, and nothing shows that what they do is equally achievable or exported through the API. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API parity with Inspector/NME/Sandbox operations, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven parity, AI-friendly tooling such as an MCP server or markdown doc mirrors.
